It loses 'is not "intelligence"'. It also cuts 'autonomous, sentient artificial intelligence' down to 'sentient AI', although the contract treats autonomy and sentience as separate and lists the full phrase as an explicit element. The rationale, limitations, citations (e1 contradicts, e2 context), dates and the unresolved outcome are accurate.

The first-person 'I see no signs' wording is kept, and the interpretation, baseline ambiguity and July 29, 2024 cutoff are all visible. The rationale's claims about Quiet-STaR on a 7B model, observational scaling predicting GPT-4 from weaker models, and emergence-as-measurement-artifact all match e1 to e3. Excerpts, publishers, dates and relations are all correct.
